note: a stadium as dog_bone draws it: the 8 x 6 rectangle |u| <= 4, |v| <= 3 and at each end the major arc of a radius-5 circle about (+-8, 0) through (+-13, 0); the second arc ends on the start. The chord's half-angle is alpha = atan2(3, 4), each minor segment 25 alpha - 12, so the profile is 48 + 2 (25 pi - 25 alpha + 12) and its perimeter 16 + 2 * 5 (2 pi - 2 alpha). YZ maps local (u, v, w) to world (w, u, v); extruded 2. V = 2 area; A = 2 area + 2 perimeter
